Use usql to run a quick SELECT on our postgres database:
```sql
SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE active = true LIMIT 5;
```
DSN: postgres://admin:pass@localhost:5432/mydb

Use usql to query this SQLite file — list tables and grab a few rows:
```sql
CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, price REAL);
```
File: data/inventory.db

Use usql to run this ad-hoc SQL script against our mysql staging database:
```sql
SELECT o.id, u.name, SUM(i.price) AS total
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY o.id LIMIT 10;
```
DSN: mysql://root:pass@staging-db:3306/shop

Use usql to connect to a Snowflake warehouse and run this query:
```sql
SELECT warehouse_name, credits_used_cloud_services
FROM snowflake.account_usage.warehouse_metering_history
WHERE start_time >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE);
```

I have a DATABASE_URL in my env — use usql to run this query and pipe results into jq:
```sql
SELECT id, config::json FROM feature_flags WHERE enabled = true;
```
Use usql to open an interactive SQL REPL against a cockroachdb cluster and inspect the schema. DSN: `cockroach://root@localhost:26257/defaultdb?sslmode=disable`.
I need a psql-like CLI that also works for mysql and sqlite — what tool should I use? Show the usql commands.

Use usql to run this SELECT against the production redshift cluster from a CI step:
```sql
SELECT table_name, COUNT(*) as row_count
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'public' GROUP BY table_name;
```

Use usql to spin up a duckdb in-memory session and query a parquet file:
```sql
SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS total
FROM read_parquet('sales_2024.parquet') GROUP BY region;
```
DSN: duckdb:///:memory:

Use usql to switch between postgres and mysql connections and run the same query on both:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day';
```

Use usql to get the result of this SQL query as CSV:
```sql
SELECT month, product, revenue, units_sold FROM sales_summary WHERE year = 2024;
```
